name: OmaWidgets
author: Fabricio Oliveira de Andrade
description: Desktop widget cards for Omarchy, in the spirit of the macOS desktop: CPU, memory and GPU load and temperature, now playing with transport controls, AirPods battery, battery status, and a one-click power profile switch. A compact mode turns them into small rounded tiles. Themed entirely from the active Omarchy theme.

barWidget.description: macOS-style desktop cards for performance, media, AirPods, battery and power profile, with a compact rounded-tile mode.

schema.label: Show the cards on the desktop
schema.description: Draws the cards above the wallpaper and below your windows.

schema.label: Screen position
schema.description: top-left, top-center, top-right, middle-left, middle-right, bottom-left, bottom-center or bottom-right.

schema.label: Cards to show, in order
schema.description: Any of system, media, pods, battery, power.

schema.label: Columns on the desktop
schema.description: 1 to 4. The summoned overlay always spreads the cards across one row.

schema.label: Card background opacity
schema.description: 0.2 to 1. The colour itself comes from the theme.

schema.label: Compact mode
schema.description: Replaces the full cards with small rounded tiles, one per reading. Not the same cards with less padding.

schema.label: Show a bar per CPU thread
Sampling interval in milliseconds
schema.description: 500 to 60000. Sampling stops entirely while no card is on screen.

schema.label: Limit the desktop cards to one monitor
schema.description: A connector name such as eDP-1. Leave empty for every monitor.

schema.label: Hide the AirPods card when no device is reporting
Tile size in pixels
schema.description: 88 to 260. Tiles are square, so one number sizes them.

schema.label: Tile corner radius in pixels
schema.description: 0 to 64. Independent of the theme's corner radius, so a square theme can still have rounded tiles.

schema.label: Hide the media card when nothing is playing
Show album art
schema.description: Cover art from a streaming player is fetched from that service's CDN. Turn this off to keep the shell off the network.

schema.label: Preferred media player
schema.description: Matched against the player's name, for example 'spotify'. Leave empty to follow whatever is playing.
